entities.summary: Sacsayhuamán or Saksaywaman is a citadel on the northern outskirts of the city of Cusco, Peru, the historic capital of the Inca Empire. The site is an important example of Inca architecture. The site is at an altitude of 3,701 metres (12,142 ft).
